Instructions for Use
Device description: The Tern Infusion Pump is a implantable drug pump. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Tern Infusion Pump is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5T only
· a maximum spatial field gradient of 30 T/m (3,000 gauss/cm) or less
· Gradient slew rate limited to 100 T/m/s per axis
· Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 2 W/kg
· Limit total active scanning to 20 min
· Wait 30 minutes before the next imaging session
· Any receive-only coil may be used
· RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
· Device configuration: MRI SureScan mode
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Tern Infusion Pump is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
